'''Haven Paschall''' (born '''Haven Burton''') is an American voice actress and singer for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}. She is also a Broadway stage actress.

==Biography==
Little is known about Paschall's personal life, other than she became a voice actress as an adult. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during [[S16|the sixteenth season]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} and provided the voices of several characters, most notably [[Anthea and Concordia|Concordia]]. In {{aniseries|XY}}, she received her most prominent role, {{an|Serena}}. In addition to her voice-over work, Paschall has sung a few songs for the series. As of {{aniseries|HZ}}, she is credited by her birth name.
